title: High-risk groundwater zones needing protection: undeveloped land (Morrow County, OR)
required_outputs: undeveloped_areas.tif (pred_results/; output/undeveloped_areas.tif as literally instructed is also accepted)
method: Align land_cover.tif (Oregon North metres, 30 m, larger extent) to the vulnerable_areas.tif grid (Oregon North US feet, 98.4 ft) with nearest-neighbour resampling. Standardise vulnerable areas to 1-10 using the min/max of valid cells (14/37), reclassify NLCD codes with the given table, risk_zones = vul*8 + lc*10; keep risk_zones > 100 and, within it, the undeveloped classes (codes 31, 41, 43, 52, 71, 81, 90, 95), keeping the land-cover code as value. Gold: 665 cells (0.60 km2): 601 Hay/Pasture, 62 Barren, 2 Shrub/Scrub.
benchmark_defects: The two inputs are on different grids and in different linear units (vulnerable areas: StatePlane Oregon North US feet; land cover: Oregon North metres, larger extent); the task does not mention it, but array-index map algebra is wrong.
The instruction asks to save to 'output/undeveloped_areas.tif' rather than pred_results/.
With the given weights, Herbaceous and the wetland classes can never exceed 100, and forest/shrub only on the most vulnerable cells, so the result is tiny (665 cells).
checks: required: selected cells (valid & > 0) sampled at gold cell centres (pyproj) overlap the gold selection, IoU >= 0.70
required: every land-cover class of the gold selection with >= 20 cells (Hay/Pasture 81, Barren 31) has recall >= 0.5
optional: values are the undeveloped land-cover codes
optional: selected area within +/-25 % of gold
